sequence.description: Max Schuemann challenged (pitch result), call on the field was confirmed: Max Schuemann called out on strikes.
Paul Goldschmidt lines out softly to second baseman Nico Hoerner.
Amed Rosario strikes out on a foul tip.
Seiya Suzuki grounds out, second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. to first baseman Paul Goldschmidt. Pete Crow-Armstrong to 3rd.
Alex Bregman flies out to center fielder Spencer Jones.
